changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6f, item 1 (R52): renamed Dispatcher.hooks.beforeLaunch to Dispatcher.hooks.launch and Team.hooks.beforeTeamLeaderLaunch to Team.hooks.leaderLaunch. Pure rename of the plugin hook property names; no behavior, ownership, or firing-site change. A plugin authored against the old names must rename its own tap registrations to compile against this dreamux-types version.
